# Overview

A **quantitative trait locus (QTL)** is a region of the genome that explains part of the variation in a quantitative trait, here plant height in a maize mapping population. This report compares four methods of increasing power:

| Method | Idea | R/qtl function |
|---|---|---|
| Single-marker analysis (SMA) | Test each marker on its own | `scanone(method = "mr")` |
| Interval mapping (IM) | Also test positions *between* markers using genotype probabilities | `scanone(method = "hk")` |
| Composite interval mapping (CIM) | IM plus marker cofactors that absorb other QTL | `cim()` |
| Multiple-QTL mapping (MIM) | Fit several QTL and their interactions together | `fitqtl()`, `refineqtl()`, `stepwiseqtl()` |

Significance thresholds come from **1,000 permutations**. These control the genome-wide type I error at α = 0.05.

# Genetic map

```{r map}
load(data_file)
summaryMap(maize.mds)
plotMap(maize.mds)
plotRF(maize.mds, col.scheme = "redblue")
```

# Single-marker analysis

```{r sma}
maize.mr <- scanone(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "mr")
maize.perm.mr <- scanone(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "mr",
                         n.perm = 1000, verbose = FALSE)
plot(maize.mr, type = "p", main = "Single-marker analysis (SMA)")
add.threshold(maize.mr, perms = maize.perm.mr, alpha = 0.05, lty = 2)
knitr::kable(summary(maize.mr, perms = maize.perm.mr, alpha = 0.05))
```

# Interval mapping (Haley-Knott regression)

```{r im}
maize.mds <- calc.genoprob(maize.mds, step = 1)
maize.im <- scanone(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "hk")
maize.perm.im <- scanone(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "hk",
                         n.perm = 1000, verbose = FALSE)

plot(maize.mr, maize.im, type = c("p", "l"), col = c("black", "red"), main = "SMA versus IM")
add.threshold(maize.mr, perms = maize.perm.mr, alpha = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "black")
add.threshold(maize.im, perms = maize.perm.im, alpha = 0.05, col = "red")
legend("topright", legend = c("SMA", "IM"), lty = c(2, 1), col = c("black", "red"))

maize.im.sig <- summary(maize.im, perms = maize.perm.im, alpha = 0.05)
knitr::kable(maize.im.sig)
```

## Effects of the IM peaks

```{r im-fit}
maize.mds <- sim.geno(maize.mds, step = 1)
maize.im.qtl <- makeqtl(maize.mds, chr = maize.im.sig$chr, pos = maize.im.sig$pos)
maize.im.fit <- fitqtl(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", qtl = maize.im.qtl,
                       formula = y ~ Q1 + Q2, get.ests = TRUE)
summary(maize.im.fit)
```

# Composite interval mapping

Window sizes of 10, 15, 20 cM and the whole chromosome were compared, with 2√n marker cofactors.

```{r cim}
n_cov <- 2 * sqrt(nind(maize.mds))
cim_ws <- lapply(c(10, 15, 20, Inf), function(ws)
  cim(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "hk", n.marcovar = n_cov, window = ws))
names(cim_ws) <- c("ws10", "ws15", "ws20", "wsInf")

maize.perm.cim <- cim(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "hk",
                      n.marcovar = n_cov, window = Inf, n.perm = 1000)

plot(maize.im, cim_ws$ws15, cim_ws$ws20, col = c("red", "blue", "green"), main = "IM versus CIM")
add.threshold(maize.im, perms = maize.perm.im, alpha = 0.05, col = "red")
add.threshold(cim_ws$ws10, perms = maize.perm.cim, alpha = 0.05)
add.cim.covar(cim_ws$ws20, col = "green")
legend("topright", c("IM", "CIM (ws = 15)", "CIM (ws = 20)"), lty = 1, col = c("red", "blue", "green"))

knitr::kable(summary(cim_ws$ws20, perms = maize.perm.cim, alpha = 0.05))
```

# Multiple-QTL model

## Starting model from CIM peaks

```{r mim-start}
maize.mds <- calc.genoprob(maize.mds, step = 1)
maize.qtl <- makeqtl(maize.mds, chr = c(2, 7, 7, 10), pos = c(80.0, 110.0, 111, 69.4))
maize.ref <- refineqtl(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", qtl = maize.qtl,
                       formula = y ~ Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4, verbose = FALSE)
plotLodProfile(maize.ref)
summary(fitqtl(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", qtl = maize.ref,
               formula = y ~ Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4, get.ests = TRUE))
```

## Penalties from a two-dimensional scan

```{r scantwo}
perm.2dim <- scantwo(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "hk",
                     n.perm = 1000, verbose = FALSE)
penalties <- calc.penalties(perm.2dim)
penalties
```

## Forward/backward stepwise search

```{r stepwise}
maize.step <- stepwiseqtl(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", max.qtl = 6,
                          method = "hk", penalties = penalties, verbose = FALSE)
maize.step
```

## Final six-QTL model and interactions

```{r final}
maize.qtl3 <- makeqtl(maize.mds, chr = c(2, 6, 7, 7, 8, 10),
                      pos = c(78.0, 81.7, 51.0, 111.1, 60.6, 69.4))
f6 <- y ~ Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4 + Q5 + Q6
maize.ref3 <- refineqtl(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", qtl = maize.qtl3,
                        formula = f6, verbose = FALSE)
plotLodProfile(maize.ref3)
addint(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", qtl = maize.ref3, formula = f6)
summary(fitqtl(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", qtl = maize.ref3,
               formula = f6, get.ests = TRUE))
```

```{r two-scan}
maize.mds <- calc.genoprob(maize.mds, step = 2)
maize.two <- scantwo(maize.mds, pheno.col = "PlantHeight", method = "hk", verbose = FALSE)
plot(maize.two, col.scheme = "redblue")
summary(maize.two)
```
